source.actorRule: user_type_exempt([2]); internal roles1-5, with writer-current role/assignment/epoch checks
source.totalScope: role1: active stores; roles2-5: all assigned stores, including inactive
source.total: COUNT(order_stores INNER JOIN orders ON orders.id=order_stores.order_id WHERE orders.order_status<>0)
source.monthly: COUNT(joined associations WHERE order_status<>0 AND YEAR(orders.created_at)>=businessCurrentYear), grouped by store/year/month
source.zeroDate: Exact all-zero wall date remains in total; normalized monthly DATETIME is NULL. Retain the original zero wall string for source hash. Reject other unrepresentable wall dates.
source.ambiguity: Different counts for the same store/month across years are refused. Equal counts retain the source overwrite result.

factsView.order_store_id: STRING exact positive decimal PK, unique within generation
factsView.store_id: STRING exact positive decimal store ID
factsView.order_id: STRING exact positive decimal order ID
factsView.order_status: INT64 nonnull source order_status; no dimension-table remapping
factsView.order_created_at: DATETIME source wall time; nullable only for a proved all-zero original wall date
factsView.source_created_at_wall: STRING canonical source wall date including all-zero sentinel, retained for source/warehouse digest reconciliation

publicationsView.store_id: STRING exact store ID; one row per physical store, including zero-fact stores
publicationsView.as_of: TIMESTAMP shared verified source snapshot time for the entire generation
publicationsView.source_count: INT64 or canonical integer STRING: all joined associations, including status0
publicationsView.warehouse_count: INT64 or canonical integer STRING, equal to source_count
publicationsView.source_hash: lowercase SHA256 of canonical source joined rows
publicationsView.warehouse_hash: same canonical SHA256 over normalized warehouse joined rows
publicationsView.complete: BOOL; TRUE only after independent scope/count/digest/source-checkpoint reconciliation

digest.row: JSON array of five strings: [order_store_id,store_id,order_id,decimal_order_status,source_created_at_wall] followed by LF
digest.order: numeric order_store_id ascending within each store
digest.emptyStore: SHA256 of the empty UTF8 byte sequence
digest.pii: No customer, operator contact, payment, wallet or address fields are needed.

requiredPublisherAcceptance: Demonstrate a common source snapshot/checkpoint for order_stores and orders; independent CDC timestamps are insufficient.
Capture immutable source counts/digests and normalized warehouse counts/digests per store from the same generation, including explicit zero-store manifests.
Keep source DATETIME wall values; BUSINESS_TIMEZONE must match the source production date boundary.
Verify duplicate-association, nonzero/missing-status-dimension, inactive-store, orphan, zero-date, future-year and full-width-ID fixtures.
Publish complete only after source equality and authorized-reader scope reconciliation; do not edit a complete generation.
Test actual BQ SQL, authorization, freshness and scan plans with the accepted publication. This file and synthetic tests are not deployment acceptance.

observedRawEvidence.limitations: Raw tables exist with independent CDC apply progress and one-hour max_staleness; no proved common source generation or matching dashboard publication exists in the saved discovery. No live data/publications were changed.
